name: Layla
source:
[url=/c175728]Flynn[/url]'s best friend. She's been by Flynn's side since they were small children and has had his back through everything from then until now. Her mind is something to be amazed by. If you can think of something, she can usually find a way to make it a reality.

[Edited from in-game description]
